investigation: PSI-26 BASS and PSI-25 BASS-II (non-fabric solids): PMMA rods, spheres, spherical sections, films and slabs in a slow duct flow in the Microgravity Science Glovebox
description: Third law of the plastics (docs/wsp/research/phys_bass_study.md section 4, PROTOCOL 13.6): the seven bass2 features plus u_pot1 and is_one_sided. Derived by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py from condition fields only.

features.name: x_o2
features.description: oxygen mole fraction of the gas entering the duct during the step

features.name: nose_radius
features.description: radius of the rod, sphere or spherical section as installed; 0.01 for a flat sample (weight zero in the flat targets)

features.name: heat_time
features.description: time from ignition of this burn to the end of the step (for quench and blow-off speeds: to the event); 200 where it is not recorded

features.name: is_concurrent
features.description: flat samples: 1 if the flame spreads with the flow, 0 against it; 0 for rods and spheres

features.name: is_rod
features.description: 1 if the sample is a rod (any flow configuration); 0 for spheres, sections and flat samples

features.name: flat_thickness
features.description: flat samples: thickness as installed; rods, spheres and sections: 0.0005 (weight zero)

features.name: u_pot1
features.description: the burn's fan curve at fan display 46.5 (pot 1), m/s

features.name: is_one_sided
features.description: flat samples: 1 if sides_burning is 1, else 0; rods, spheres, sections: 0

targets.name: holds_low_flow
targets.description: rod tip or sphere: flame not quenched by heat loss at the end of the step

targets.name: holds_high_flow
targets.description: rod tip or sphere: stagnation flame not blown off

targets.name: oxygen_limit
targets.description: rod tip or sphere: oxygen fraction at which the flame goes out at this speed and time

targets.name: quench_speed
targets.description: rod tip or sphere: duct speed below which the flame goes out

targets.name: blowoff_speed
targets.description: rod tip or sphere: duct speed at which the stagnation flame blows off

targets.name: flat_holds_low_flow
targets.description: film or slab: flame not quenched

targets.name: flat_holds_high_flow
targets.description: film or slab: flame not blown off

targets.name: flat_quench_speed
targets.description: film or slab: duct speed below which the flame goes out
